subject.title: Feature: fallbackChannel for hook mappings when primary delivery fails

question: Should hook mappings gain a public `fallbackChannel` or `fallbackChannels` config surface, and what exact authorization and retry semantics should apply after primary delivery fails?
rationale: This changes public hook config and cross-channel delivery behavior, including where potentially private hook output may be sent after a failure; code inspection shows the shape is missing but does not settle the product/security contract.

options.title: Design typed fallback chain
options.body: Add an explicit ordered fallback config with authorization checks, clear primary-failure conditions, and tests for primary success, fallback success, and all-targets-failed reporting.

options.title: Use failure notifications only
options.body: Keep completion delivery single-target and document `failureDestination` or cron alerts as the supported notification path when primary delivery fails.

options.title: Decline core fallback config
options.body: Preserve single-target hook delivery and require operators to choose one reliable delivery channel or implement custom routing outside core.

recommendation.title: Design typed fallback chain
recommendation.body: Add an explicit ordered fallback config with authorization checks, clear primary-failure conditions, and tests for primary success, fallback success, and all-targets-failed reporting.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior issue review and recent adjacent gateway/cron documentation history make this the clearest routing candidate for the product decision.
